'''Cipher Eight''' was a codename of a [[Cipher Agent]] within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The agent [[Death/Legends|died]] during the infiltration of the [[Tytun Rings]] - a massive, self-maintaining repository of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] communications.
